create_auth_decision: create an AuthDecision instance to represent an allowed or denied HTTP request with an optional error status code
create_auth_level: create an AuthLevel enum value (NORMAL, ADMIN_OPTIONAL, or ADMIN_FORCE) to mark an endpoint's authentication requirement
build_auth_level_decorator: build an auth_level decorator that attaches an AuthLevel to a FastAPI endpoint function via metadata
test_decide_request_auth: test the decide_request_auth function with method, path, authorization header, api keys, and auth level to verify auth decisions
